DECØY DEVICES // PCB ARTWORK SUITE
✓ 100% PURE MONOCHROME (Binary Single-Polarity Vectors)
✓ 0 <text> TAGS — All typography vectorized as explicit paths
✓ 0 <clipPath> TAGS — Safe for all KiCad / EDA polygon parsers
